stops.note: the name for the small, spineless psychoactive cactus
Nahuatl 'peyotl'; the Huichol still make pilgrimages to gather it
the Native American Church, founded in 1918, uses peyote as a sacrament
stops.meaning: a small psychoactive cactus used in indigenous ceremonies

current_meaning: a small, spineless cactus containing psychoactive compounds, used ceremonially by some Indigenous peoples
